input_hashes.scope: graph, scoring, social, and YC local input envelope plus profiler runtime files; canonical runtime values and effective scoring/calibration/confidence sources are hashed separately

methodology.before: Re-normalize each cohort's production-assembled evidence and aggregate company plus founder evidence with the imported production scoring functions.
methodology.after: In memory only: retain only rows accepted by the production scoring-eligibility predicate, audit but retain publication-date gaps under the production conservative-momentum behavior, canonicalize metrics with the production normalizer, apply entity-scoped production canonical dedupe, and apply the production physical-post comparator only to eligible rows with one unambiguous company owner before re-running the same production scorer.
methodology.published_reference: Published company scores are reported separately because cohort dataset builders can apply calibration after the exported aggregate scorer.
methodology.rank_rule: Ordinal rank by score descending, then company name and company ID ascending.
perturbations: increase every positive configured metric by 1 percent
increase one configured metric for a deterministic score-stratified sample of up to 40 rows per platform by max(1, ceil(value * 1 percent))

outliers.method: Tukey 1.5 IQR fences; evidence uses log1p(raw production-weighted engagement), company scores use the 0-100 score directly, and samples smaller than four are not classified.

monotonicity.sample_selection: Evenly spaced by production raw engagement within each platform.
